annotation.title_clean: Legislative Recommendations: A National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Legislative Recommendations: A National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.summary_en: March 2026 White House legislative recommendations for a national AI policy framework. It urges Congress to protect children, manage data-center energy impacts, address copyright and digital replicas, protect free speech, create sandboxes, avoid a new AI regulator, build workforce skills, and preempt burdensome state AI laws.
key_provisions_or_claims: Congress should preempt state AI laws imposing undue burdens, with carve-outs for generally applicable state laws, zoning and state own-use.
No new federal AI rulemaking body; use existing sector regulators and industry-led standards.
Establish federal regulatory sandboxes and make federal datasets AI-ready.
Child protections: age assurance, parental controls, and features reducing exploitation and self-harm risks.
Leave AI training copyright questions to courts; consider digital replica protections and collective licensing.
